wikipedia#3.title: 1971: Prospero (flight spare pictured), the first British satellite launched on a British rocket, lifted off from Launch Area 5B in Woomera, South Australia.

wikipedia#4.title: 1965: In St. Louis, Missouri, U.S., the 630-foot (190 m)-tall steel catenary Gateway Arch was completed.

wikipedia#5.title: 1940: World War II: Italy invaded Greece after Greek prime minister Ioannis Metaxas rejected Benito Mussolini's ultimatum demanding the cession of Greek territory.

wikipedia#6.title: 1928: Indonesian composer Wage Rudolf Supratman introduced "Indonesia Raya", now the country's national anthem.

wikipedia#7.title: 1925: The funerary mask of Tutankhamun, possibly originally made for Queen Neferneferuaten, was uncovered for the first time in approximately 3,250 years.

wikipedia#8.title: 1919: The U.S. Congress passed the Volstead Act over president Woodrow Wilson's veto, reinforcing Prohibition in the United States.

wikipedia#9.title: 1886: In New York Harbor, U.S. president Grover Cleveland dedicated the Statue of Liberty (pictured), a gift from France commemorating the Declaration of Independence.

wikipedia#10.title: 1835: In the first major engagement of the Texas Revolution, the Texian Army repelled a Mexican attack at the grounds of Mission Concepcion south of Downtown San Antonio.

wikipedia#11.title: 1776: American Revolutionary War: As George Washington's Continental Army retreated northward from New York City, the British Army captured the village of White Plains.

wikipedia#12.title: 1707: The Hōei earthquake ruptured all segments of the Nankai megathrust simultaneously – the only earthquake recorded to have done so.

wikipedia#13.title: 1664: The Duke of York and Albany's Maritime Regiment of Foot, the forerunner to the Royal Marines, was established at the grounds of the Honourable Artillery Company in London.

wikipedia#14.title: 1640: The Treaty of Ripon was agreed, ending the Second Bishops' War and forcing Charles I to summon the Long Parliament, ultimately leading to the First English Civil War.

wikipedia#15.title: 1453: Ladislaus the Posthumous was crowned King of Bohemia, although George of Poděbrady remained in control of the government.

wikipedia#16.title: 312: Civil wars of the Tetrarchy: Constantine the Great defeated Maxentius at the Battle of the Milvian Bridge in Rome.
